# Lana Society

> A calm, appointment-only skin studio in Waxahachie, TX (serving the Dallas / DFW area), founded by licensed esthetician Alana Cervantes. Personalized facials, targeted enhancements, and brow services — thoughtful, results-focused skincare in a private, unhurried space. Tagline: real skin, thoughtful care, lasting confidence.

## Contact & booking
- Website: https://www.lanasociety.com/
- Email: Lanasociety.connect@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/lanasociety.skin
- Booking: Square Appointments, appointment-only; a deposit reserves your time, balance due at the visit
- Location: Waxahachie, TX — private studio, exact address shared after booking
- Areas served: Waxahachie, Dallas, Duncanville, Cedar Hill, Midlothian, DeSoto, Red Oak, Ennis (DFW, Texas)

## Facials
Personalized facial experiences tailored to the guest's skin — from a first Skin Introduction consultation, to a foundational Essential facial, to advanced Skin Renewal treatments addressing acne, pigmentation, texture, and signs of aging. Seasonal: O2 Glow oxygenating treatment.

## Facial enhancements (added to any facial)
- Dermaplaning — +$35
- Microdermabrasion — +$35
- LED Light Therapy — +$20
- High Frequency — +$15
- Cold Globes — +$15
- Lip + Eye Treatment — +$15
- Gua Sha — +$10
